description: Read one numbered part of a published MFM document or dataset (an id returned by search that starts with "portfolio:" recomputes the portfolio calculator, nothing stored). Company metadata includes verification_level, audit_id, audit_url and controls_performed. metadata.next_id identifies the following part or is null. Audit levels describe programme membership; source dates, units, missing values and verification limits are included in the record.

model_id.description: Optional identifier of the model used for the inspection; client-declared, not model attestation.

name: fetch
title: Read a public MFM record
